headline: Keefe, Bruyette & Woods Maintains Market Perform on Cincinnati Financial, Lowers Price Target to $190
summary: Keefe, Bruyette & Woods  analyst Meyer Shields   maintains Cincinnati Financial (NASDAQ:CINF) with a Market Perform and lowers the price target from $201 to $190.
